title: designs-fano-plane widget params
description: Bespoke clickable Fano plane (PG(2, 2)): clicking a line highlights its three collinear points; clicking two points highlights their joining line. Concrete instance of the smallest projective plane and a stepping stone to the [7,4,3] Hamming code via Fano lines.
